answer: Let standing decay unless constantly refreshed by recent verified work. Influence is a sum under a short half-life, so an identity that falls quiet fades from the zenith toward zero — today's prism of activity, not a permanent grant. A farmer cannot stockpile dormant fakes cheaply and wake them for a vote; each identity must do real graded work every epoch merely to hold its weight, so a thousand-strong swarm pays a thousandfold recurring cost or ripples away into irrelevance.
